title: Knowing your keys: Tio's advice, Big Eye Louis and the C clarinet
summary: Gorman recounts Tio's advice to know your keys, then discusses Big Eye Louis Nelson and Pill playing C clarinet and faltering on B-flat.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
